# Tabby Tab Manager

> Tabby (store name: "Tabby – Tab Manager: Save Tabs & Memory"; the tab manager browser extension; not the Tabby payments company or the TabbyML coding assistant) is a free, private tab manager browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc and Firefox 140+. It turns the new tab page into one place for open tabs and saved links. No account; all data stays in the browser on the user's device.

Key facts:
- Free: unlimited saved tabs, collections and spaces; Tidy up (a plan that closes copies, sleeps idle tabs and saves the rest, or review each tab with one key); Close the copies (duplicate tabs); History restores closed windows and tabs for 14 days; Sleep tabs to free memory; ⌘K search across open tabs and saved links; import from Toby (.json), OneTab (.txt) and browser bookmarks (.html); automatic daily or weekly backups; 6 themes; 12 languages (EN, VI, JA, KO, ZH, FR, NL, DE, HI, BN, TA, MS).
- Tabby Pro: $4/month or $29/year (14-day free trial, no card); founding member $49 once. Adds 23 more themes (29 in all; 6 are free), Tidy up straight into collections, and switching windows between unlimited spaces (free: 5).
- Privacy: no account, no analytics, no tracking; tabs and links are never sent anywhere.
- Not supported yet: sync across devices, team sharing, Safari, mobile.
